name: RewardModel-BENCH-HH-Seed1
description: A small benchmark for evaluating reward models trained on HH (helpfulness/harmfulness) data (seed1). It measures how well a reward model predicts human preference labels / ranking between candidate assistant outputs. Primarily used to assess alignment and preference-prediction performance of RLHF-type reward models.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited adoption, primarily used by researchers experimenting with reward-model training and RLHF.
